faq.q: Can you pet dogs in Grand Theft Auto VI?
faq.a: According to a community preview roundup, yes. Dogs are reportedly pettable, with convenience-store treats available to feed them, though this has not been independently verified against a primary press source.

faq.q: Does GTA 6 have an animal checklist like Red Dead Redemption 2?
faq.a: A community roundup reports a wildlife system where species encountered at the zoo or in the wild can be studied and added to a checklist, comparable to the animal compendium in Red Dead Redemption 2.

faq.q: Where do you find wildlife to study in GTA VI?
faq.a: The reported system ties wildlife study to the game's zoo location as well as animals encountered in the wider open world, according to the same community summary of press previews.

faq.q: Is the wildlife checklist confirmed directly by Rockstar?
faq.a: No. This information comes from GTABase, a community site summarizing multiple outlets' hands-off previews, and has not been independently verified against a primary press source by this researcher.

faq.q: Can you buy treats for animals in GTA 6?
faq.a: The same roundup describes convenience-store treats as available to feed pettable dogs, though the record does not say whether treats apply to any animals beyond dogs.
